claims.claim: On Friday the government of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced an expansion of the gasoline subsidy, with an exemption of 0.89 reais that zeros all PIS/Cofins on the fuel, on the eve of the second round.
claims.episode_span: The exemption will be 0.89 reais. O Globo reports that this zeros all PIS/Cofins on the fuel.
claims.source_title: Governo amplia subsídio para gasolina às vésperas do segundo turno das eleições
claims.supporting_quote: O governo Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) anunciou nesta sexta-feira a ampliação do subsídio para gasolina, às vésperas do segundo turno. A desoneração será de R$ 0,89, o que zera todo o PIS/Cofins sobre o combustível.

claims.claim: Federal justice charged former judge María Laura Garrigós de Rébori, former intervenor of the Federal Penitentiary Service, for not installing signal inhibitors or controlling phone entry, and bosses such as Guille Cantero kept giving orders from prison with those phones.
claims.episode_span: The court found she did not install signal inhibitors and did not control the entry of telephones.
claims.source_title: Procesaron a la exjueza María Laura Garrigós de Rébori por la falta de controles a los jefes narco en las cárceles
claims.supporting_quote: La justicia federal consideró que la exinterventora del Servicio Penitenciario Federal no instaló inhibidores de señal ni controló el ingreso de teléfonos. Con esos aparatos, capos como Guille Cantero siguieron dando órdenes desde prisión.

claims.claim: Anvisa on Friday ordered the recall of all lots of Peptistrong, made by Manipulação Stevia Ltda. (Biostevi Pharma), because hydrolyzed fava-bean protein had not passed a safety evaluation for food use, and suspended manufacture, distribution, sale, advertising, and use under resolution 3,967/2026.
claims.episode_span: Anvisa, ordered on Friday the recall of every lot of Peptistrong, made by Manipulação Stevia Ltda. (Biostevi Pharma).
claims.source_title: Anvisa determina recolhimento de suplemento Peptistrong
claims.supporting_quote: A Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa) determinou, nesta sexta-feira, o recolhimento de todos os lotes do produto Peptistrong, fabricado pela empresa Manipulação Stevia Ltda. (Biostevi Pharma).

claims.claim: The Dominican Auxiliary Police trained 60 young people to mediate conflicts in their neighborhoods through a ministerial program focused on emotional tools and effective communication.
claims.episode_span: The Dominican Auxiliary Police trained 60 young people to mediate conflicts in their neighborhoods
claims.source_title: 60 jóvenes mediarán conflictos en sus barrios dominicanos como medida de prevención de violencia nacional
claims.supporting_quote: La Policía Auxiliar dominicana capacitó a este personal mediante un programa ministerial enfocado en herramientas emocionales y comunicación efectiva para detener la violencia comunitaria antes de que esta escale peligrosamente

claims.claim: A 28-year-old woman died on a Volaris flight from Tijuana to Tapachula; a necropsy linked the death to cardiorespiratory arrest, and the body was released for burial in Acacoyagua.
claims.episode_span: A 28-year-old woman died on a Volaris flight from Tijuana to Tapachula, in Chiapas
claims.source_title: Mulher de 28 anos sofre parada cardiorrespiratória e morre durante viagem de avião no México
claims.supporting_quote: Os resultados associaram o óbito a uma parada cardiorrespiratória.

claims.claim: Mexico's government presented a decree that will require platforms to remove accounts or violent content for minors, and if they do not comply the government would proceed by law.
claims.episode_span: Mexico's government presented a decree that will require platforms to remove accounts or content that is violent for minors
claims.source_title: Obligan a plataformas bajar contenido violento para menores
claims.supporting_quote: Gobierno presentó decreto que obligará a plataformas a retirar cuentas o contenido violento para menores, y si no cumplen, se iría por ley.

claims.claim: At a rally in Ceilândia, Lula said Brazil will not be governed by fascism, by those he called assassins of thousands in Covid-19, or by the partner of Banco Master and Vorcaro's relatives, and he cited an alleged theft of 12 billion reais from the BRB.
claims.episode_span: Lula said this country "will not again be governed by fascism" or by "those assassins of thousands of people in Covid-19,"
claims.source_title: Em primeiro ato do 2º turno, Lula cita fascismo, 'assassinos' da pandemia e Master para atacar Flávio
claims.supporting_quote: Esse país não voltará a ser governado pelo fascismo, não voltará a ser governado por aqueles assassinos de milhares de pessoas na Covid-19. Esse país não será governado pelo sócio do Banco Master, pelos parentes do Vorcaro

claims.claim: Flávio says the money he sought from Daniel Vorcaro is private, while the Federal Police is investigating whether it financed Eduardo Bolsonaro's activity in the United States against Brazilian authorities.
claims.episode_span: Flávio says the money is private.
claims.source_title: Em primeiro ato do 2º turno, Lula cita fascismo, 'assassinos' da pandemia e Master para atacar Flávio
claims.supporting_quote: Flávio diz ser dinheiro privado, e a Polícia Federal investiga se os recursos financiaram a atuação de Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP) nos Estados Unidos contra autoridades brasileiras.

claims.claim: In the first round on October 4, Lula received 45.2 percent of valid votes and Flávio 47 percent; the runoff is October 25. Grass received 34.47 percent, and a Datafolha poll released Thursday has Celina Leão at 55 percent and Grass at 37 percent.
claims.episode_span: Lula 45.2 percent, Flávio 47 percent, on Sunday, October 4 — and a runoff on October 25.
claims.source_title: Em primeiro ato do 2º turno, Lula cita fascismo, 'assassinos' da pandemia e Master para atacar Flávio
claims.supporting_quote: No primeiro turno, realizado no domingo (4), o petista obteve 45,2% dos votos válidos , enquanto o adversário alcançou 47%.

claims.claim: Grupo Ohla's survey released October 8 found 41 percent of senior retail executives in 21 countries expect economic improvement, with Peru's optimists rising from 30 percent to 79 percent, Chile from 18 to 53, and Colombia from 17 to 45.
claims.episode_span: 41 percent of senior consumer and retail leaders in 21 countries expect their national economy to improve
claims.source_title: Retail in Latin America: Optimism grows, prices climb
claims.supporting_quote: Forty-one percent of senior consumer and retail leaders in 21 countries expect their national economy to improve, according to Grupo Ohla’s VII Latin American Survey of Consumer and Retail Executives, released Oct. 8.

claims.claim: In the same survey, 57 percent expect higher prices in six months, Argentina has 63 percent foreseeing a margin decrease and 5 percent an increase, and USDA ERS figures cited put 2021 import shares at 60 percent of fresh fruit availability and 38 percent of fresh vegetables.
claims.episode_span: 57 percent regionally expect higher prices over the next six months
claims.source_title: Retail in Latin America: Optimism grows, prices climb
claims.supporting_quote: Regionally, 57% of respondents expect higher prices in the coming six months.
